text: One objection to arbitration of corporate governance disputes holds in Europe as in the United States: arbitration as ordinarily used yields little relevant precedent.
citation: Christian Kirchner, Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro (2004). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=617681

isBasedOn.name: Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro

abstract: Coffee has one objection to arbitration of corporate governance disputes that is as persuasive in Europe as in the United States. Arbitration, as it is used in most contexts, yields little relevant precedent.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: arbitration as it is used in most commercial contexts
